capacityDerivation: 2 equipment crates x 2 fixed cells; one cost-1 handling unit per cell
cargoYawRule: every item rides at yaw90: plan footprint X=itemD, Z=itemW; itemD<=220, itemW<=320, itemH<=160
cartFrame: GLB Y-up meters, cart length along Z, scale 1.0, no rescale

crate.reuse: W1-accepted derivative, byte-identical reuse, no re-conversion

deckWitness: 25 vertical rays through actual GLB deck triangles hit 290.72893..290.72898mm; crate-bottom slabs verified free of cart-triangle intrusion (vertex + edge-crossing checks)
docksNote: crateOriginY = deckTopYM - crateMinY so the crate bottom skin rests exactly on the deck plane; dock gap 406.2-405.133277=1.0667mm positive separation (no penetration); cart-frame docks shift by normalizationZ into unit frame
floorNote: measured min above 0 by 0.37 micron; recorded, no Y shift applied (negligible, would be false precision in placement)
normalizationNote: whole cart+cargo assembly shifts by +41.02388mm in GLB Z (source centerZ=-41.02388); no independent cart/cargo shifts, no scale; rendered yaw stays canonical per holonomic disc assumption
profileNote: centered 680x1220+100; ceil(hypot(680,1220)/2)+100=799; loaded union (cart+crates) verified inside
unitFrame: unit origin = footprint center; cart mesh + docks + cells all carry normalizationM; length along Z
